SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, FINPROD_ABBR text, FINPROD_ID finprodId FROM FIN_PRODUCT INNER JOIN PTL_MANAGE_OBJ ON PTL_MANAGE_OBJ.MANAGE_OBJ_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ON PTL_MANAGE_OBJ.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID = #{userName} where FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F16,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PROFIT_TYPE IN (#{PROFIT_TYPE_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PROFIT_TYPE_03,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
AND (FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) or FINPROD_ABBR LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) )

SELECT FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR text, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID || ',' || FIN_PRODUCT.PROFIT_TYPE || ',' || FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR || ',' || FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.DEAL_MODE object,
FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID finprodId
FROM FIN_PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_MANAGE_OBJ ON PTL_MANAGE_OBJ.MANAGE_OBJ_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ON PTL_MANAGE_OBJ.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID where FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F16,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FIN_PRODUCT.PROFIT_TYPE IN (#{PROFIT_TYPE_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PROFIT_TYPE_03,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
AND (FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) or FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) )
AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{initValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID = #{userName}
AND FIN_PRODUCT.MDATE >= to_date(#{SESSION_SYS_DATE},'yyyy-mm-dd')

SELECT INT_RATE*100 intRate FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO WHERE INT_RATE_ID = #{indexId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and EFF_DATE = ( select max(EFF_DATE) from MST_INT_RATE_INFO where INT_RATE_ID = #{indexId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EFF_DATE <= to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') )

SELECT DISTINCT A.INT_RATE*100 intRate, B.WEIGHT weight FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO A, MST_INDEX_COMPONENT B WHERE B.INDEX_ID = #{indexId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND B.COMPONENT_ID = A.INT_RATE_ID AND A.EFF_DATE IN ( SELECT MAX(C.EFF_DATE) FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO C, MST_INDEX_COMPONENT D WHERE D.INDEX_ID = #{indexId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND D.COMPONENT_ID = C.INT_RATE_ID AND C.EFF_DATE <= to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') GROUP BY D.COMPONENT_ID )
select INDEX_TYPE indexSource from MST_INDEX_INFO where INDEX_ID = #{indexIdSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT distinct BASE_RULE_ID as baseRuleId, COEFFICIENT as coefficient, RATE*100 as rate, SPREAD_RATE*100 as spreadRate, RESET_TYPE as resetType, EFF_DATE as effDate, RATE_TYPE as rateType, INDEX_ID as indexId, INDEX_SOURCE as indexSource, REMARK as remark FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and EFF_DATE = #{effDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND BASE_RULE_TYPE = #{baseRuleType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select VDATE vdate, MDATE mdate from FIN_PRODUCT where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select COUNT(1) from FIN_CASH_INFO A, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE B where A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND A.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_C04,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND B.EFF_DATE > to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') UNION ALL select COUNT(1) from FIN_CASH_INFO C, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE D where C.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND C.CASH_ID = D.CASH_ID AND C.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_C04,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND D.EFF_DATE > to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
UNION ALL select count(1) from BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE where BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE.FEE_TYPE = #{CASH_TYPE_2_C04,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE.CDATE > to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL E,TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL F WHERE E.TRADE_ID = F.TRADE_ID AND E.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND E.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND E.SETTLE_DATE> to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND F.FEE_TYPE = #{CASH_TYPE_2_C04,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND E.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
